summary.en: A big word and one line at the left; at the right a procedural field round the anchor acts the feature out and steps one state a beat; on paper or reversed out of ink.
summary.zh: 左边一个大词加一行字；右边围着锚点的程序场把功能演出来，每拍走一步；纸底或墨底反白。

fits: One feature per card in a launch: interference, separation, a log, a waveform, a grid filling in.
notFor: Features that need a screenshot; more than one line of copy.

intent.en: Each feature is acted out by the picture: the field round the anchor changes its function to show what the word means.
intent.zh: 每个功能由画面演出来：锚点周围的场改变自己的函数，表现这个词的意思。

content.en: A word (≤ 11 chars / 6 字), a line (≤ 32 / 16 字), an optional label (≤ 30 / 16 字), a field kind, paper or ink; `print: 'blocks'` after a dot-quantize seam.
content.zh: 一个词（≤ 11 字符 / 6 字），一行字（≤ 32 / 16 字），可选标签（≤ 30 / 16 字），场的种类，纸底或墨底；接在 dot-quantize 之后用 `print: 'blocks'`。

fits.zh: 发布片里一卡一个功能：干涉、分离、日志、波形、网格填满。

notFor.zh: 需要截图的功能；超过一行文案。

en: Cards with the same `pattern` draw the same field: reuse it only when the film means 'the same one again'.
zh: `pattern` 相同的卡画同一个场：只在片子要说“又是同一个”时复用。

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)
